title: Publish the bounded Attempt investigation query projection

gates.name: Python typecheck
gates.command: docker compose run --rm --no-deps backend python -m mypy src/face_moment

gates.name: Attempt investigation query tests
gates.command: docker compose run --rm backend python -m pytest tests/promo/test_attempt_investigation_queries.py

evidence_required: .memory-bank/contracts/attempt-investigation-api.md#promo-query-boundary RED: the promo owner exposes only single-row repository reads and no accepted bounded investigation query, so diagnostics cannot obtain exact server/correlation/time/state projections without foreign-table access; GREEN: one promo application query returns immutable core projections for the exact typed filters with conjunctive semantics, deterministic newest-first ordering, a 100-row cap and no ORM/write authority; decisive comparison: seeded identities, all processing states, boundary timestamps and more than 100 matches against returned values plus unchanged owner rows; artifact: focused query and ownership evidence under .tasks/TASK-088-T2-FT-008-W1/.
purpose: Publish the smallest promo-owned read boundary that lets diagnostics investigate existing Attempts without direct foreign-table access or new persistence.
success_outcome: Diagnostics can request bounded immutable Attempt projections by exact server/correlation identity, UTC time and processing state, with deterministic ordering/cap and unchanged promo-owned state.
anti_goals: Do not expose ORM entities, arbitrary predicates/sorts, pagination, exports or a generic query service.
Do not implement staff HTTP/UI, role authorization or read diagnostics-owned evidence.
Do not add a table, migration, index, materialized read model or second identity scheme.

forbidden_scope: Diagnostics evidence writes, staff authorization/UI and FT-009 server events
Database migrations, production Attempts and operator/default data
Promo Attempt/result/session mutations beyond proving they remain unchanged
stop_conditions: The query cannot remain a read-only promo-owned application boundary returning immutable projections.
Exact attempt_id/correlation_id behavior would require a new persisted identity or schema change.
A sufficient query would require arbitrary filtering, pagination or a materialized diagnostic read model.
Stateful proof cannot use disposable owner-scoped rows with known initial state, safe rerun and cleanup.

constraints: Primary owner and code root are promo at src/face_moment/promo/; diagnostics is the consumer across the accepted read-only edge.
Map public attempt_id to PromoAttempt.id and correlation_id to client_attempt_id without adding an alias column.
Apply conjunctive filters, created_at DESC plus attempt_id DESC ordering and the 100-row maximum inside the provider boundary.
Use task-owned disposable Attempts with controlled UTC values, safe rerun and cleanup limited to those fixtures.
invariants: Promo remains the sole core Attempt writer; the new boundary performs no mutation.
No consumer receives ORM entities or direct promo repository/table authority.
Client monotonic values and server timestamps remain separate and nullable stages stay nullable.
The accepted module graph and diagnostics -> promo edge remain unchanged.
verification_targets: Repository/application fixtures prove both exact identities, conjunctive typed UTC/state filtering, every state, deterministic ties and the 100-row cap without changing owner rows.
Ownership/import inspection proves the projection stays in promo, returns no ORM entity and introduces no diagnostics-table read, migration or new persistence model.
